required.hint: White Card (CPCCWHS1001) or Standard 11 GI induction

required.hint: driver licence/driver's license/QLD open or P

positives.name: Exposure to stackers, draglines, conveyors, ports
Basic mechanical/electrical aptitude

Good teamwork and communication
positives.hint: works well in teams, communicates clearly

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia

notes.unknown_policy: If a required item is not clearly in the CV, mark as Unknown. If more than max_unknown_required are Unknown, verdict should lean 'Unsure – Needs Manual Review'.
notes.site_ready_tip: White Card OR Standard 11 is acceptable as site readiness.
